name: Dashboard
acceptance: Real-data counts with scoped permissions; no fabricated operational metrics; pilot owner approval.

name: Property Setup
acceptance: Persist full hierarchy, property types, timezone, currency, images and policies with validation and tenant-safe onboarding.

name: Staff & Roles
acceptance: Role matrix, invitations, revocation and negative permission tests for every scoped operational role.

name: Reports & Analytics
acceptance: Reconciled business-date definitions, permission-filtered reports, exports and verified lineage.

name: Booking Engine
acceptance: Parallel last-room holds, quote/tax revalidation, idempotent payment/confirmation/cancellation and widget UAT.

name: PMS & Front Desk
acceptance: Calendar and full stay lifecycle, room moves and immutable history pass pilot desk UAT.

name: Central Reservations
acceptance: Authorized cross-property search and transfers preserve inventory authority and booking source.

name: Group Bookings
acceptance: Rooming lists, blocks/pickup, attrition and group check-in/out pass allocation and finance tests.

name: Guest CRM
acceptance: Guest deduplication, consent, preferences and stay history preserve privacy boundaries.

name: Inventory Management
acceptance: Canonical append-only movements, atomic holds/expiry and last-room concurrency tests; physical units/beds/resources remain distinct.

name: Channel Manager
acceptance: Durable inbound/outbound adapters, dedupe, ordering, retries/DLQ, outage recovery and each provider certification.

name: OTA Mapping
acceptance: Explicit property/room/rate/occupancy/currency/tax mapping with unmapped-room warnings and audited changes.

name: Revenue Management
acceptance: Defined ADR/RevPAR/forecast inputs, backtesting and source-accurate reconciled reports.

name: Rate Shopping
acceptance: Licensed competitor data, rate parity and freshness checks; no unauthorized scraping.

name: Rate Management
acceptance: Occupancy/child/meal pricing, taxes, restrictions and deterministic precedence with precision tests.

name: Dynamic Pricing
acceptance: Explainable guarded recommendations, caps, approvals and rollback history.

name: Google Hotel Ads
acceptance: Approved feed access, landing-page price parity and conversion attribution checks.

name: GDS & Wholesalers
acceptance: Contracted allocations, net rates and provider reconciliation.

name: Housekeeping
acceptance: Authorized task/shift assignments and inspected/dirty/clean transitions with staff UAT.

name: Maintenance
acceptance: Assets, downtime and preventive tasks propagate sellability blocks with SLA evidence.

name: Restaurant POS
acceptance: Orders, taxes, KOTs, reversals and room-folio posting reconcile at outlet close.

name: Resort Activities
acceptance: Slots, waivers and resource/staff conflict prevention; package consumption tests.

name: Events & Banquets
acceptance: Proposals/contracts, catering, group room blocks and deposits reconcile to event profitability.

name: QR Guest Services
acceptance: Guest/room verification, service requests and ordering expose no cross-room information.

name: Payments & Refunds
acceptance: PSP signature/replay tests, uncertain-state reconciliation, partial refunds and immutable postings.

name: Accounting & GST
acceptance: Effective-dated taxes, GSTIN and invoice/credit-note rounding pass professional tax review.

name: OTA Reconciliation
acceptance: Channel commissions, taxes, payout differences and replay-safe reconciliation.

name: Corporate Ledger
acceptance: Contracted corporate/agent AR/AP and aged ledger balances reconcile with journals.

name: WhatsApp & Messaging
acceptance: Approved provider consent, opt-out and unified-message security tests.

name: WhatsApp Automation
acceptance: Approved templates, journey triggers, dedupe and retry guards; no unconsented campaign sends.

name: AI & Automation
acceptance: Grounded/explainable assistance, human approval, evaluation and tenant-safe knowledge access.

name: AI Chatbot
acceptance: Grounded FAQs, safe tools, handoff and prompt-injection/isolation evaluation.

name: Loyalty & Promotions
acceptance: Points, tiers, vouchers and member-rate rules reconcile with bookings and finance.

name: Marketing & Reviews
acceptance: Consent-based campaigns, attribution, SEO and review workflows with deletion/opt-out.

name: Multi-property
acceptance: Chain/brand hierarchy, property scopes, rollups and authorized transfers with group UAT.

name: Integrations & API
acceptance: Versioned contracts, credentials/OAuth, signed webhooks, quotas and documented replay behavior.

name: Security & Audit
acceptance: Tenant/RLS, MFA, key rotation, device/session controls, audit and tested recovery.

name: Subscription Billing
acceptance: Plan changes, invoices, dunning and idempotent billing webhooks; quotas and entitlement tests.

name: Settings
acceptance: Scoped settings changes, validation, safe defaults, audit and infrastructure boundaries.
